verses.en: And after Abimelech there arose to defend Israel Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar; and he dwelt in Shamir in mount Ephraim.
verses.pt: E Depois de Abimeleque levantou-se para livrar a Israel, Tolá filho de Puá, filho de Dodô, homem de Issacar, o qual habitava em Samir, no monte de Efraim.
verses.en_web: After Abimelech, Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar, arose to save Israel. He lived in Shamir in the hill country of Ephraim.
verses.en_bbe: Now after Abimelech, Tola, the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar, became the saviour of Israel; he was living in Shamir in the hill-country of Ephraim.

verses.en: And he judged Israel twenty and three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.
verses.pt: E julgou a Israel vinte e três anos, e morreu, e foi sepultado em Samir.
verses.en_web: He judged Israel twenty-three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.
verses.en_bbe: He was judge over Israel for twenty-three years; and at his death his body was put to rest in the earth in Shamir.

verses.en: And after him arose Jair, a Gileadite, and judged Israel twenty and two years.
verses.pt: Depois dele se levantou Jair, gileadita, o qual julgou a Israel vinte e dois anos.
verses.en_web: After him Jair, the Gileadite arose, and he judged Israel twenty-two years.
verses.en_bbe: And after him came Jair the Gileadite, who was judge over Israel for twenty-two years.

verses.en: And he had thirty sons that rode on thirty ass colts, and they had thirty cities, which are called Havoth-jair unto this day, which are in the land of Gilead.
verses.pt: Este teve trinta filhos que cavalgavam sobre trinta asnos, e tinham trinta vilas, que se chamaram as vilas de Jair até hoje, as quais estão na terra de Gileade.
verses.en_web: He had thirty sons who rode on thirty donkey colts, and they had thirty cities, which are called Havvoth Jair to this day, which are in the land of Gilead.
verses.en_bbe: And he had thirty sons, who went on thirty young asses; and they had thirty towns in the land of Gilead, which are named Havvoth-Jair to this day.

verses.en: And Jair died, and was buried in Camon.
verses.pt: E morreu Jair, e foi sepultado em Camom.
verses.en_web: Jair died, and was buried in Kamon.
verses.en_bbe: And at the death of Jair his body was put to rest in the earth in Kamon.

verses.en: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD, and served Baalim, and Ashtaroth, and the gods of Syria, and the gods of Zidon, and the gods of Moab, and the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines, and forsook the LORD, and served not him.
verses.pt: Mas os filhos de Israel voltaram a fazer o mal aos olhos do SENHOR, e serviram aos baalins e a Astarote, e aos deuses da Síria, e aos deuses de Sidom, e aos deuses de Moabe, e aos deuses dos filhos de Amom, e aos deuses dos filisteus:
verses.en_web: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and served the Baals, the Ashtaroth, the gods of Syria, the gods of Sidon, the gods of Moab, the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines. They abandoned Yahweh, and didn’t serve him.
verses.en_bbe: And again the children of Israel did evil in the eyes of the Lord, worshipping the Baals and Astartes, and the gods of Aram and the gods of Zidon and the gods of Moab and the gods of the children of Ammon and the gods of the Philistines; they gave up the Lord and were servants to him no longer.

verses.en: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he sold them into the hands of the Philistines, and into the hands of the children of Ammon.
verses.pt: E o SENHOR se irou contra Israel, e vendeu-os por mão dos filisteus, e por mão dos filhos de Amom:
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of the Philistines, and into the hand of the children of Ammon.
verses.en_bbe: And the wrath of the Lord was burning against Israel, and he gave them up into the hands of the Philistines and into the hands of the children of Ammon.

verses.en: And that year they vexed and oppressed the children of Israel: eighteen years, all the children of Israel that were on the other side Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which is in Gilead.
verses.pt: Os quais moeram e quebrantaram aos filhos de Israel naquele tempo dezoito anos, a todos os filhos de Israel que estavam da outra parte do Jordão na terra dos amorreus, que é em Gileade.
verses.en_web: They troubled and oppressed the children of Israel that year. For eighteen years, they oppressed all the children of Israel that were beyond the Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which is in Gilead.
verses.en_bbe: And that year the children of Israel were crushed under their yoke; for eighteen years all the children of Israel on the other side of Jordan, in the land of the Amorites which is in Gilead, were cruelly crushed down.

verses.en: Moreover the children of Ammon passed over Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim; so that Israel was sore distressed.
verses.pt: E os filhos de Amom passaram o Jordão para fazer também guerra contra Judá, e contra Benjamim, e a casa de Efraim: e foi Israel em grande maneira afligido.
verses.en_web: The children of Ammon passed over the Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim, so that Israel was very distressed.
verses.en_bbe: And the children of Ammon went over Jordan, to make war against Judah and Benjamin and the house of Ephraim; and Israel was in great trouble.

verses.en: And the children of Israel cried unto the LORD, saying, We have sinned against thee, both because we have forsaken our God, and also served Baalim.
verses.pt: E os filhos de Israel clamaram ao SENHOR, dizendo: Nós pecamos contra ti; porque deixamos a nosso Deus, e servido aos baalins.
verses.en_web: The children of Israel cried to Yahweh, saying, “We have sinned against you, even because we have forsaken our God, and have served the Baals.”
verses.en_bbe: Then the children of Israel, crying out to the Lord, said, Great is our sin against you, for we have given up our God and have been servants to the Baals.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto the children of Israel, Did not I deliver you from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?
verses.pt: E o SENHOR respondeu aos filhos de Israel: Não fostes oprimidos pelo Egito, pelos amorreus, pelos amonitas, dos filisteus,
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to the children of Israel, “Didn’t I save you from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to the children of Israel, Were not the Egyptians and the Amorites and the children of Ammon and the Philistines

verses.en: The Zidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, did oppress you; and ye cried to me, and I delivered you out of their hand.
verses.pt: Dos de Sidom, de Amaleque, e de Maom, e clamando a mim vos livrei de suas mãos?
verses.en_web: The Sidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, oppressed you; and you cried to me, and I saved you out of their hand.
verses.en_bbe: And the Zidonians and Amalek and Midian crushing you down, and in answer to your cry did I not give you salvation from their hands?

verses.en: Yet ye have forsaken me, and served other gods: wherefore I will deliver you no more.
verses.pt: Mas vós me deixastes, e servistes a deuses alheios: portanto, eu não vos livrarei mais.
verses.en_web: Yet you have forsaken me, and served other gods. Therefore I will save you no more.
verses.en_bbe: But, for all this, you have given me up and have been servants to other gods: so I will be your saviour no longer.

verses.en: Go and cry unto the gods which ye have chosen; let them deliver you in the time of your tribulation.
verses.pt: Andai, e clamai aos deuses que escolhestes para vós, que vos livrem no tempo de vossa aflição.
verses.en_web: Go and cry to the gods which you have chosen. Let them save you in the time of your distress!”
verses.en_bbe: Go, send up your cry for help to the gods of your selection; let them be your saviours in the time of your trouble.

verses.en: And the children of Israel said unto the LORD, We have sinned: do thou unto us whatsoever seemeth good unto thee; deliver us only, we pray thee, this day.
verses.pt: E os filhos de Israel responderam ao SENHOR: Pecamos; faze tu conosco como bem te parecer: somente que agora nos livres neste dia.
verses.en_web: The children of Israel said to Yahweh, “We have sinned! Do you to us whatever seems good to you; only deliver us, please, today.”
verses.en_bbe: And the children of Israel said to the Lord, We are sinners; do to us whatever seems good to you: only give us salvation this day.

verses.en: And they put away the strange gods from among them, and served the LORD: and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.
verses.pt: E tiraram dentre si os deuses alheios, e serviram ao SENHOR; e sua alma foi angustiada por causa do sofrimento de Israel.
verses.en_web: They put away the foreign gods from among them, and served Yahweh; and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: So they put away the strange gods from among them, and became the Lord's servants; and his soul was angry because of the sorrows of Israel.

verses.en: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together, and encamped in Gilead. And the children of Israel assembled themselves together, and encamped in Mizpeh.
verses.pt: E juntando-se os filhos de Amom, assentaram acampamento em Gileade; juntaram-se assim os filhos de Israel, e assentaram seu acampamento em Mispá.
verses.en_web: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together and encamped in Gilead. The children of Israel assembled themselves together and encamped in Mizpah.
verses.en_bbe: Then the children of Ammon came together and put their army in position in Gilead. And the children of Israel came together and put their army in position in Mizpah.

verses.en: And the people and princes of Gilead said one to another, What man is he that will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? he shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.
verses.pt: E os príncipes e o povo de Gileade disseram um ao outro: Quem será o que começará a batalha contra os filhos de Amom? Ele será cabeça sobre todos os que habitam em Gileade.
verses.en_web: The people, the princes of Gilead, said to one another, “Who is the man who will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? He shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.”
verses.en_bbe: And the people of Israel said to one another, Who will be the first to make an attack on the children of Ammon? We will make him head over all Gilead.
